blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — Malacañang has ordered the removal of Chinese-run fish cages in Pangasinan province, which was first exposed by the Inquirer. Palace spokesperson Claire Castro announced on Thursday during a visit here. Castro, citing a statement from Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., said the directive would resolve complaints made by local fishermen
